signals.text: 3 new PM roles posted this week

roles.title: AVP, Senior Product Manager - Agentic Workflows

bullets: Partner directly with business teams to understand workflows, identify operational challenges, and uncover opportunities for AI-enabled automation.
Regularly engage with users at offices and field locations to observe processes, gather insights, and validate product opportunities.
Translate business needs into clear product requirements and maintain a prioritized backlog of AI workflow initiatives.
Design, build, test, and iterate AI-powered workflow prototypes using modern AI tools, development platforms, and techniques.
Present prototypes and proposed solutions to stakeholders, gather feedback, and continuously refine workflows based on user needs and business outcomes.
Manage day-to-day client communications, responding to questions, coordinating requests, escalating issues, and keeping stakeholders informed and unblocked.
Own the execution rhythm of client projects, coordinating with internal development teams and maintaining accurate project status, documentation, and release information.
Use project management tools such as GitHub Projects and Jira to track deliverables, dependencies, blockers, and timelines.
Analyze client data to identify gaps, discrepancies, risks, and requirements that may affect implementation outcomes.
Support senior product and engineering stakeholders with functional gap analysis and solution architecture discussions.
Own the product lifecycle from strategy and rapid prototyping through early user cohorts, iteration, launch, and ongoing optimization.
Define the product vision, target audience, positioning, distribution strategy, category narrative, and long-term business opportunity in partnership with Product Marketing.
Establish a clear product philosophy for trustworthy AI, determining when an AI experience should guide, ask questions, or take action while ensuring users remain in control.
Run rapid build-measure-learn cycles, prototyping frequently, testing concepts with users and experts, and quickly discontinuing approaches that lack supporting evidence.
Define product success metrics, instrumentation, and unit economics, including understanding and managing the cost of serving AI-powered experiences.
